design_coverage.reason: Use the stated standard-error procedure and its year/firm grouping; distinguish group-based cross-sectional construction from absorbed fixed effects.
Apply the source-reported estimator and fit structure. Any essential estimator ambiguity is separately listed as a blocking issue.
Reproduce the paper’s reported year/industry effects or its industry-year construction groups; if not reported, do not add absorbed effects.
Use source keys and validity-dated links where multiple products are joined; unresolved links remain explicit.
Apply the source-defined transformations, timing, rank normalization, winsorization and exclusions without tuning to reported coefficients.
Apply the frozen observation population, period, missing-data rules and stated exclusions; all calendar/year bounds remain as recorded in the source.
The assigned baseline specification does not report observation weights.

implementation_issues.description: Eq. (3) defines DIFRS* as observed binary IFRS adoption, whereas Appendix 2 Table 9 describes DIFRS* as the ex ante adoption probability; this changes the probit/Lambda construction.
The variance window for VarGDP is not reported; the required historical country-growth window cannot be bounded from the text.
GDiff is attributed to Bae et al. (2008), but the underlying country-year source table and exact values have not been verified.

review_notes: The local Worldscope, Datastream, Compustat Global, IBES International and linkage tables have matching field proofs; local historical coverage is unconfirmed. IMF/WDI public metadata are verified but target-country values are not. GDiff and VarGDP remain specifically unresolved.
